title: Integral Equation Methods for Scattering by Multifractal Obstacles
summary: Caetano et al. (Proc. R. Soc. A. 481:20230650, 2025) have proposed a formulation for sound-soft acoustic scattering by a compact scatterer O $\subset$ Rn, in which the scattered field is represented as an acoustic Newtonian potential whose density is the solution of an operator equation on a compact set $Γ$ $\subset$ O.
